en_title: Techland CEO Addresses Fans as Dying Light: The Beast Support Comes to an End
subtitle: 五年支持模式未达预期
opus_summary: Techland确认《消逝的光芒：困兽》结束支持，不再计划推出大规模新内容。负责人表示，五年支持模式未达预期，维护旧作会干扰新项目开发，《消逝的光芒2》仍将获得支持。

paragraphs.en: Techland’s founder and CEO, Paweł Marchewka, recently hosted a Discord AMA with fans of the company’s parkour-fueled zombie series, during which he announced the end of support for Dying Light: The Beast . The game landed last year as a standalone release, despite its original positioning as an expansion for Dying Light 2.
paragraphs.cn: Techland创始人兼CEO Paweł Marchewka近日在Discord举办问答活动，与旗下跑酷丧尸系列的粉丝交流，并宣布《消逝的光芒：困兽》将结束支持。这款游戏最初定位为《消逝的光芒2》的扩展内容，但最终于去年独立发售。

paragraphs.en: The Beast recently got the Restored Land update , which allowed players to clear out the zombies across the map and bring civilization back to the world. But now support is ending for The Beast, which Techland never planned as a game the company would support long term.
paragraphs.cn: 《消逝的光芒：困兽》最近推出了Restored Land更新，玩家可以清除地图各处的丧尸，让文明重返这个世界。但如今，这款游戏的支持即将结束，Techland从未打算长期支持本作。

paragraphs.en: Dying Light: The Beast is a complete game, and that’s how players should approach it — much like Dying Light 1 is today,” Marchewka said, via Insider Gaming . “We’re not planning substantial new content for it.”
paragraphs.cn: 据Insider Gaming报道，Marchewka表示：「《消逝的光芒：困兽》是一款完整的游戏，玩家也应该这样看待它，就像如今的《消逝的光芒》一样。我们没有为它推出大规模新内容的计划。」

paragraphs.en: Marchewka went on to say that The Beast was planned as a “complete, self-contained game from the start.” The company never made a commitment to it, but still put out substantial free updates over the past year, including Restored Land, new weapons, and more.
paragraphs.cn: Marchewka接着表示，《消逝的光芒：困兽》「从一开始就计划做成一款完整、独立成篇的游戏」。公司从未承诺长期支持本作，但过去一年仍推出了大量免费更新，包括Restored Land、新武器等内容。

paragraphs.en: “The five-year support model hasn’t worked as well for us as we hoped,” Marchewka continued. “We’re an AAA studio. With each new game, we want to deliver an unforgettable experience and push the boundaries of what games can do.”
paragraphs.cn: Marchewka继续说道：「五年支持模式的效果没有达到我们的预期。我们是一家3A工作室。每推出一款新游戏，我们都希望带来难忘的体验，突破游戏所能实现的极限。」

paragraphs.en: The CEO went on to explain how supporting multiple games can impact development on the studio’s next release. “Supporting existing games for years with smaller teams can seriously disrupt work on new projects,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: Marchewka随后解释了同时支持多款游戏会如何影响工作室下一部作品的开发。他说：「让规模较小的团队长期支持已有游戏，可能会严重干扰新项目的开发。」

paragraphs.en: “At the same time, players expect frequent, substantial, high-quality updates — sometimes several times a month, and usually for free. With limited resources, we can end up disrupting production and still disappointing players.”
paragraphs.cn: 「与此同时，玩家希望游戏频繁推出内容充实、品质出色的更新，有时一个月就要好几次，而且通常还得免费。资源有限，我们最终可能既打乱了开发进度，又让玩家失望。」

paragraphs.en: The team will continue to support Dying Light 2, which still has a larger team working on updates than Dying Light ever had. Techland’s next game was supposed to be its fantasy RPG project , but that was canceled last year.
paragraphs.cn: 团队将继续支持《消逝的光芒2》。目前负责本作更新的团队规模，仍超过《消逝的光芒》历来任何时期的更新团队。Techland的下一款游戏原本应该是旗下的奇幻RPG项目，但该项目已于去年取消。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox One and PS4 versions of The Beast were also canceled earlier this year. What Techland is working on next remains a mystery for now.
paragraphs.cn: 《消逝的光芒：困兽》的XBOX One和PS4版本也已于今年早些时候取消。Techland接下来正在开发什么，目前仍是个谜。
